items.headline: Google’s AlphaGenome 2 zooms in on the cellular roots of disease
items.excerpt: Researchers at Google DeepMind have unveiled a new AI model designed to unravel how changes in our DNA affect different cells, giving scientists a more detailed view of a notoriously difficult problem that could hold important clues to the causes of disease - and point the way to new treatments.
